desc.en: A vicious, large carnivorous beast that roams the desert. It will eat anything, including plants and rocks, and even the occasional Slag it encounters. This troublesome beast sometimes even attacks human ships as a result.
desc.ja: 砂漠を疾走する凶暴な大型肉食獣。雑食で肉以外にも植物や岩、時には徘徊しているスラグすら餌にしてしまう。好き嫌いなく人間の船も襲ってくる迷惑な獣
